== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Keder The Black (V) (Errata)]] (<code>1250_9</code>, Virtual Block 5 slip 07), showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. No published image shows this text: the Virtual Block 5 release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB5-07-Keder_The_Black.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB5-D-kedertheblack-pre.gif]]) both show the original text of [[Keder The Black (V)]].

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee website card list (VBlock5Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064732/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock5Type.html 2012-07-21] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111153832/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock5Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive). The card list drops icons; the icons are those of the printed slip. Published typos are kept as printed (the missing closing quotation mark after “senators”, “Squabling”).
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “While at Senate: Sidious is politics +3; “senators on Squabling Delegates is treated as “Coruscant Guards;” and may lose 1 Force to place Keder and an opponent’s [Coruscant] Political Effect (or [Coruscant] senator here) in owner’s Lost Pile.”
* '''Made:''' 9 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 72) from the card's own Virtual Legacy card (<code>1250_9</code>: Decipher art, frame, title, lore with “spy” in bold as printed, icons, Virtual Block 5 set mark, slip number 07, copyright line) with the PC-E1 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
